description:
Pirate Utility Pack

A ship pack of utility/combat pirate ships focused on exploring scraping/mining and resource transport.

Includes the ships and wings shown below which are added to the pirate BP and feature several logistical features as well as a custom naming feature for all pirate ships.

Mod technical notes

Spoiler

All PUP ships are combat specialists that have a utility aspect associated to them.Each ship has better armor than standard but suffer from weaker hulls and inefficient shields. Most ships have associated mining strengths that interact with Nexerelin's mining feature and are equipped with mining/custom drones. All ships are deployable and have a mix of utility and combat.Many have salvage gantries, two have high resolution sensors, one has surveying equipment, one has a ground support package, two have an operation center, one has a Nav Relay, one has a custom ramming system and one has drive field stabilizers.All ships and wing are available for purchase in pirate markets and have been added to the pirate blueprint.The included naming feature is a list fo 70 custom tongue in cheeck pirate themed names. If this feature is not for you, you can go to the mod folder then navigate to data\strings and there is a file called ship_names.json, open it with an simple editor (notepad++ is a good free one) and delete the ones you dislike.I feel that each ship and wing added fills a role that is currently missing in the pirate lineup and I may be adding more as ideas and suggestions arise.

[close]

ANOTHER Dazs mod?! you ask. Well here is my reasoning:

SpoilerOver the years I have been asked by a couple players to add pirate ships to one of my other mods, JYD, which focuses on salvage and mining. At the time I eventually decided to not do that and the ships I toyed around with just sat on my drive. Recently I read a player complaining that that pirates lack any utility ships of their own and rely on independent hulls and that did not make sense to them since they clearly have combat ships designed by them. Top that off with a post by catfish on the Spiral Arms II thread of ships they designed for personal use and were free to use. Well my mods all about filling in holes in the game that I feel need filling and this inspired me to make these ships. So I dug out my old designs, used some of catfish's sprites and kit bashed the above ships. I do hope you like them.

[close]

Sources & Thank Yous

SpoilerEach PUP ship is a Dazs kit bash using a mix of vanilla art assets and fee to use content posted on Spiral Arms II

Note: catfish, who posted a fair amount of the art I used on Spiral Arms II posted: No need to give credit. Well I feel the need and thank you for sharing them with the community.

Beta Testers: blueharizon, Kherae, happycrow, Quantum86, lchronosl, Selfcontrol, BlackOrb, Craboblab, TheCrispyDud and Sourdough - Thank you all for your input and appreciation!

A special thank you to Alex and team for their hard work making this game and keeping it up to date all these years.

[close]

If you enjoy my content, please consider buying me a coffee to keep me going! :) on

Ko-Fi

Current Changelog

v0.5.3  Save Compatible  - NOTE: If you had Blast Doors on a save game Grueling you may need to reallocate OP

-Grueling: Replaced the built-in hull mod Missile Autoforge with Blast Doors - TY Perq and TheCrispyDud for noting it was not in line with a ramming ship role

-Rockchopper: Raised the deployment and supply use from 28 to 30 - TY Levidos for noting it needed an adjustment

Previous Changelog

Spoilerv0.5.2  Save Compatible

-Scallywag: Fixed an error with the flux regen being 3000 instead the intended 300 - TY Green Ghost for noting it

-Scallywag: Increased the cargo from 400 to 500 - TY again Green Ghost for your commentary

-Corrupt: Widened the rear side-facing hard points from 15 degrees to 35 degrees - It was having trouble engaging enemies

-Mule Tender(P): Increased the supply per month and deployment cost from 7 to 9 to account for the extra armor - TY EagleShark for noting it

-Went through each description and fixed some grammatical mistakes - I could have just ignored them and claimed Pirates were illiterate :)

v0.5.1  Save Compatible

-Changed the display name of the Ichronosl to the Xebec - My apologies to Ichronosl for the misunderstanding

v0.5.0 Save Compatible - Note: Tried my best to balance them but I am looking for feedback on the new ships

-Added a new ship, the Whydah: A cruiser sized combat freighter that focuses more on combat than freighter with shielded holds and insulated engine assembly

-Added a new ship, the Ichronosl: A capital sized 6 wing battle carrier/monster with Advanced Ground Support - TY Ichronosl, TheCrispyDud and Quantum86 for helping me dial it in

-Added a new ship, the Matey: A destroyer sized combat carrier with 2 wings and High Resolution Sensors - Same TY as above

-Added a new ship, the Avast: A cruiser sized front line armored combat carrier with 3 wings, damper field, chassis storage and recovery shuttles - Same TY as above

-Dillon: Raised the deployment and supply usage from 18 to 20 - TY SC Gunship for noting that it was too much power for the deployment cost

-Slightly raised the frequency that PUP ships will appear in pirate fleets - To help compete with other pirate themed mods settings

-@Quantum86: I was unable to get the Orion drive to work with the Ichronosl so I went with a custom script ram drive

v4.9 Save Compatible Note: You may need to rearm some of the ships changed in this update if you have them in your saved fleet

-Dillon: Reduced the supply use from 20 to 18 - I believe I overcorrected in the previous patch - TY KalHirol for the suggestion

-Scallywag: Increased the flux dissipation from 280 to 300 - To help alleviate the overload it can suffer

-Rockchopper: Raised the shield arc from 170 to 180 - Because even numbers just feel better

-Scorn: Lowered the OP from 140 to 130 and removed the hardened shields from the standard variant - Was a tad OP - TY KalHirol

-Doubloon Wing: Replaced the two shot Hammer torpedo with the one shot version and lowered the speed to 200

-Madness: Removed all built-in wings and re-armed the standard variant

-Corrupt: Removed all built-in wings and re-armed the standard variant

-Rockchopper: Removed all built-in wings, increased the OP to 240 and re-armed the standard variant

-Note: The changes to the above three ships was due to reading multiple negative comments regarding built-in wings and I am all about player choice

v4.8 Save Compatible

-Adjusted the description for the Dutch - TY TheCrispyDud for the suggestion

-Dillon: Raised the supply use from 10 to 20 - Fixing an oopsie on my part that made it way too OP to deploy - TY KalHirol for noting it

v4.7 Save Compatible

-Added a new ship, the Dutch: A 6 wing, missile focused capital carrier with both ECM as well as ECCM installed - TY blueharizon for your correspondence

-Dillon: Added Nav Relay as it's built in logistics hull mod - neglected to do that when I released it

-Dillon: Replaced the ribbing along the middle sides with a more industrial sprite, widened and lined up the hangers - Received three messages that it was OCD unsettling to look at

-Reclassified the Muletender(P) as small carrier (was medium) and the Dillon as medium carrier (was large) - When I added the Dutch I noticed that I had misclassified, oopsie :(

-Added both new ship sprites to the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post - TY blueharizon & TheCrispyDud for helping me dial it in

v4.6 Save Compatible

-Added a new ship, the Alpha Wolf: A well armored command heavy destroyer for wolf pack tactics - think more tank than dps

-Added a new ship, the Grueling: A requested missile focused heavy destroyer with a custom ramming drive ship system - my TY to TheCrispyDud for all their help

-Added a new ship, the Dillon: A combat carrier light cruiser with a flexible loadout allowing the player to focus on weapon damage or wing damage

-Added the new ships to the "all ships" image found on the forum page and discord post - they are along the bottom right if interested

v0.4.5 Save Compatible

-Re-classified the Rockchooper from Combat Large to Combat Freighter Large - Better fits its role for fleet formation

-Increased the frequency pirate fleets will use PUP ships when forming their fleets - Upon review of other pirate mods, PUP was far lower

-Prometheus MK.III(P): Touched up the ship sprite - erased some stray edging, reddened the greenish/white middle and balanced the top edge - minor but less Lud and more pirate

v0.4.4 Save Compatible

-Renamed the Gangway to the Rockchopper - Name was already in use by another mod - TY spookedmoose for letting me know and TheCrispyDud for helping me bounce around names

v0.4.3 Save Compatible

-Added a new capital long haul miner, the Gangway: If the Prometheus and the Buffalo(P) had a child and militarized - TY TheCrispyDud for helping me dial it in and lchronosl for your moral support :)

-Phase Venture(P): Raised the speed from 60 to 70 and acceleration from 35 to 40 - TY TheCrispyDud for noting it was a touch too slow to engage

-Added the new ship to the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post

v0.4.2 Save Compatible

-Mule Tender(P): Added to the pirate BP - just fixing a previous oopsie

-Added a new cruiser, the Phase Venture(P): Faster, a little more fragile, phase and ballistic focused - TY lchronosl and TheCrispyDud for your input

-Added the new ship to the "all ships" image found on the forum page and discord post - It is top right if interested

v0.4.1 Save Compatible - Note: the new names only effect newly formed ships

-Added a new drone wing, the Dory: A pirate hacked talon but unmanned, armed with 4 mining lasers, 3 OP and 8 refit - TY blueharizon for the inspiration

-Replaced built-in mining drone wings with the new Dory on the following: Corrupt, Deceit, Discourteous, Madness, Pillage, Scallywag, Scorn and Muletender(p)

-Madness: Swapped out two of the previous built-in mining drone wings with Doubloon wings - Made that ship before I added the wings

-Added 70 new fun ship names for the pirates to name their ships - Akin to "The Black Pearl"

-Added the new drone to the "all ships" image found on the forum page and discord post - It is next to the Doubloon if interested

v0.4.0 Save Compatible

-Slightly increased the frequency pirate fleets will use PUP ships when forming their fleets

-Added a new Phase Capital, the Prometheus MK.III(P) - A fragile design that has high running costs but can pack a punch in a pinch and is equipped with Surveying Equipment

-Added a new Phase Destroyer, the Phase Buffalo(P) - Built as a durable combat freighter but sacrifices cargo space for an insulated engine assembly

-Added both new ships to the "all ships" image on the forum and discord post

aiDescription: Adds a variety of pirate utility and combat ships focused on mining, resource transport, and logistics. Each ship includes specialized features like mining drones, salvage gantries, sensors, and custom naming options. The mod enhances pirate fleets with new roles and improves their functionality in gameplay.
